answer.text:
The report covers the financial year ending December 31, 2025, for Sao Mai Food Joint Stock Company [p. 1](#page=1). It includes sections on shareholder letters, production activities, business results, personnel, output, dividends, investment plans, raw material prices, sustainable development, and plans for 2026 [p. 1](#page=1).

Key business results show revenue by segment in billions of VND: Food products generated 1,120 billion VND with an 8.5% growth, beverages generated 870 billion VND with a 15.2% growth, and packaging generated 460 billion VND with a -3.1% decrease [p. 4](#page=4).

The company had 3,860 employees at the end of 2025, with an average monthly income of 14.2 million VND per employee [p. 5](#page=5).

Sao Mai plans to increase the capacity of its Binh Duong factory and expand cold storage, with the project requiring an average of 120 billion VND per year [p. 8](#page=8).

In 2025, water consumption per ton of product decreased by 18% compared to 2023, and all paper packaging was collected and recycled [p. 10](#page=10).
